Trump finally threatened Russia and all countries that support Russia in the war against Ukraine with tariffs. He announced a 100% tariff on all imports from Russia and all countries that support Russia in the war against Ukraine, effective in 50 days, which is September 2, 2015. He did not mention Russia before, when he imposed tariffs on other countries, but now feels annoyed that Putin does not respect him.
